_comment: MODEL L (Assamese) reasoning finetune, run 3: worked answers. Consumed by common/finetune.py via FinetuneConfig.from_json. Keys beginning with an underscore are documentation.
_init: Starts from Model L's own Phase 2 best.pt (step 9,110, validation
loss 3.9043). finetune.py refuses a checkpoint whose model_config
names a different language. The path is the local staging directory
from common/workspace.py; pass --init to point elsewhere.
_run3: Identical to run 2's config (assamese/configs/finetune_l.json) except for three
values: use_rationale true, and evaluation every 1,000 steps on
200 validation examples, because scoring a worked answer means
generating ~40 tokens per example instead of ~3.
WHY. Run 2 learned the more/less/equal label (0.95-0.97 on
test_seen) but chose between names at chance: it always output
one of the candidates, with no first- or last-mentioned bias, so
it was not binding the comparison to the entity. Run 3 trains the
model to write that binding out: first the comparison sentence(s)
-- for chains, the whole order greatest-first -- then the marker
word and the name. Each written step is a two-way comparison or a
single retrieval, and the final choice is a lookup in text the
name: model_l_reasoning_worked
